name: launch_debugger
description: Unified debugger control. Pass action=<name> plus action-specific parameters (snake_case canonical; camelCase like addBreakpoint is also accepted). Actions: launch (start an application in debug), add_breakpoint / remove_breakpoint / list_breakpoints, set_exception_breakpoint (suspend on a raised error), run_to_line (resume to a line, one-shot), wait_for_break (block until a breakpoint hits), get_state / debug_status, get_variables, set_variable, step_over / step_into / step_out / step, resume, pause_thread (suspend a running session), set_breakpoint_state (enable or disable a breakpoint without removing it), terminate (stop a running launch by applicationId / all=true / lone active), evaluate (run a BSL expression in the current stack frame), start_profiling / get_profiling_results, help. The standalone tools (set_breakpoint, remove_breakpoint, list_breakpoints, set_exception_breakpoint, run_to_line, wait_for_break, get_variables, set_variable, step, resume, pause_thread, set_breakpoint_state, terminate_launch, evaluate_expression, debug_launch, debug_status, start_profiling, get_profiling_results) are back-compat aliases of the matching actions; prefer this facade for new prompts.

action.description: Action: launch / add_breakpoint / remove_breakpoint / list_breakpoints / set_exception_breakpoint / run_to_line / wait_for_break / get_state / get_variables / set_variable / step_over / step_into / step_out / step / resume / pause_thread / set_breakpoint_state / terminate / evaluate / start_profiling / get_profiling_results / debug_status / help (snake_case canonical; camelCase like addBreakpoint is also accepted).

topic.description: Help topic when action=help: workflow (the typical debug sequence). Without topic - lists actions.

find.description: With help: search this help for a case-insensitive substring - all the words must appear inside one chunk, and with topic only that topic is searched.

launchConfigurationName.description: launch: exact name of an EDT debug launch configuration (runtime client or Attach). Use for Attach configurations (server-side debug: HTTP services, background jobs, scheduled jobs) or to select a specific client configuration by name.

updateBeforeLaunch.description: launch: update the database before launching (default true; ignored for Attach). Under a preset that disabled update_database an omitted argument launches without updating (the answer carries databaseUpdate=SKIPPED_BY_PRESET); an explicit true is refused.

debugServerPort.description: launch: debug server port, 1..65535, when another 1C:EDT holds the default.

enableExternalObjectDump.description: launch: turn dump generation on in the project settings. Off refuses when the dump service answers; an unreachable service also refuses (Nothing was launched). true is refused by the write door of a preset that blocks writing.

externalObjectName.description: launch: open this processor or report in a client launch configuration. It is an external-object project; a ready .epf/.erf is imported first via external_object_workshop operation=import_external_object. Attach refuses it and launches nothing.

externalObjectProject.description: launch: the external-object project holding externalObjectName. Client configurations only; Attach refuses it.

startupOption.description: launch: /C only, on this launch's copy; the saved configuration is not changed. /Execute is set by the environment from externalObjectName, not by this argument. Refused for Attach and for a client already running.

clientType.description: launch: the client to start - thin, thick or web. Omitted: the launch configuration's own, thin for one created here, and thick whenever the run mode is ordinary. Applied to this launch's own configuration copy; a configuration created here is saved with it.

runMode.description: launch: ordinary or managed; omitted, the configuration's default run mode. Ordinary puts /RunModeOrdinaryApplication among the infobase's additional launch parameters for this EDT session, managed takes it out; the list on disk is not written. The answer says what changed.

waitForEndpoint.description: launch: wait for this URL to answer before reporting ready - ready is any final status below 500, at most five redirects. A launch whose endpoint never answers is NOT stopped; the refusal says so.

endpointTimeoutSeconds.description: launch: how long to wait for waitForEndpoint, default 20, limit 50. Refused without waitForEndpoint.

runKey.description: launch: resume a launch that answered Pending, by the runKey it answered with.

all.description: terminate: stop every active EDT launch (default false).

modulePath.description: BSL module path for breakpoint actions.

breakpoints.description: add_breakpoint batch: JSON array of {modulePath|module, line|lineNumber, optional condition, hitCount, hitCondition, logExpression}. projectName is inherited by items that omit it.

breakpointId.description: Breakpoint identifier for remove_breakpoint and set_breakpoint_state.

breakpointEnabled.description: set_breakpoint_state: true enables the breakpoint, false switches it off without removing it; that action refuses a call without it.

replaceModuleSet.description: add_breakpoint batch: drop the breakpoints the addressed modules already carry, so the batch is their whole set (default false).

message.description: set_exception_breakpoint: only break for exceptions whose text matches this message. Omit to break on any error.

catchAll.description: set_exception_breakpoint: break on any raised error. Default true; default false when message is set. Pass explicitly to override.

frameRef.description: Stack frame reference for get_variables / evaluate.

threadId.description: Thread id from wait_for_break - alternative to frameRef for get_variables / set_variable, and the resume target for step / resume / run_to_line. For pause_thread it names the one thread to suspend.

frameIndex.description: 0-based stack-frame index, used with threadId for get_variables / set_variable (default 0).

expandPath.description: get_variables: dot-separated path into a nested variable to expand (e.g. Struct.Field).

scope.description: get_variables: locals (default), module, or all (locals, module variables and module properties). Ignored when expandPath is set.

mode.description: Bare step action: over, into or out. step_over, step_into and step_out set it.

timeoutSeconds.description: wait_for_break / step timeout in seconds, 1..50; a longer ask is cut to 50 and said so. Aliases: timeoutMs, waitSeconds, timeout.

module.description: BSL module path for run_to_line (module-relative or absolute).

path.description: Variable name (dot-separated for nested) for set_variable.

value.description: New value as a BSL expression for set_variable.
